name: Grok Build
summary: xAI 的终端编程 agent：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: xAI's terminal coding agent: view sessions, status and full conversations; reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when it runs in tmux

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 Grok Build 在 tmux 中运行
从手机操作暂未开放（Windows 上还没实测），只能查看
回复和确认需要 Grok Build 在 tmux 中运行

limitsNote: Grok Build 不在本机记录 SuperGrok 订阅的额度，也没有提供查询接口，「今日用量」中不显示；用 xAI API Key 按量付费时请在 xAI 控制台查看余额。token 按 Grok Build 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: Grok Build doesn't record your SuperGrok plan quota on your computer and offers no way to query it, so it isn't shown under Today's usage; with pay-as-you-go xAI API keys, check your balance in the xAI console. Tokens are counted from Grok Build's own records
speaker: Grok
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.

gaps.text: Windows 上从手机回复、确认、中断还没实测，暂未开放，只能查看（Kiteline 已能往 Windows 终端里发按键，逐家实测后开放）
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming and interrupting from your phone on Windows aren't tested yet, so they're off and sessions are view-only (Kiteline can now type into Windows terminals; each agent is enabled once tested)

gaps.text: Windows 上的查看还没实测（找进程的办法换成了 Windows 也能用的）
gaps.textEn: Viewing on Windows isn't tested yet (process detection now works on Windows too)

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已全部实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (fully tested on Linux)

gaps.text: 没有用真实 Grok 账号实测（用 Grok Build 的自定义模型接口测的），登录账号后的界面若有不同，以电脑上为准
gaps.textEn: Not tested with a real Grok account (tested through Grok Build's custom model setting); if the signed-in interface differs, go by what your computer shows
